The Purana texts also mention Sharvikshaana as the father of Revata, a famous charioteer who was the teacher of Bhima, the strongest of the Pandava brothers. In these texts, Sharvikshaana is described as a king of the Vatsa kingdom, located in the Magadha region of ancient India.
